_meta.bar: Collector/museum level for seasoned players. Target reaction: 'wait, THAT is worth something?'
_meta.note: Tiers are eyeballed guesses vs a mature D2R ladder season, never a price check. Items flagged needsConcreteRoll are real categories that still need one documented specific roll before they can be written as a card. Duplicates across research files were merged.

hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.name: Death's Web
hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.keep: Poison necro grail. -50% enemy poison resist plus a good skill roll, ethereal is another tier again.

hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.name: Crown of Ages
hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.keep: Everyone knows the helm. Almost nobody has the 2-socket, 15 DR, 30 all-res roll, which is worth many times a plain one.

hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.name: Wisp Projector
hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.keep: Obscure ring where the 20% lightning absorb / 20 MF roll is the prize and most people never look at it.

hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.name: Herald of Zakarum
hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.keep: The 4-socket, high enhanced-defense roll is a paladin grail. A 0-socket low-ED one is a vendor item by comparison.

hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.name: Sandstorm Trek
hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.keep: User called this out. Ethereal Treks with a strong str/vit roll are a specific hunted item that reads as ordinary boots.

hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.name: Titan's Revenge
hiddenValue_rollDependentUniques.keep: Replenishing throwing javelins that can be ethereal and stay ethereal. A high-ED eth pair is a Javazon grail.

hiddenValue_bases.name: Jeweler's Monarch of Deflecting
hiddenValue_bases.keep: The textbook 'that blue is worth a fortune' item. Only non-pally/non-necro shield that rolls 4 sockets, and the Jeweler's/of Deflecting affixes stack block on top for casters.

hiddenValue_bases.name: Ethereal Berserker Axe
hiddenValue_bases.keep: The base for eth Breath of the Dying, one of the highest-damage weapons in the game. Superior eth 6-socket is the true grail base.

hiddenValue_bases.name: Ethereal Giant Thresher
hiddenValue_bases.keep: Fast, high-range merc base for Infinity or Insight. Ethereal 4-socket superior is what people actually hunt.

hiddenValue_bases.name: Ethereal Tomb Reaver
hiddenValue_bases.keep: A unique that self-repairs so ethereal is playable, and the 3-socket variable is the difference between good and legendary. Roll-and-socket dependent.

hiddenValue_bases.name: 45-all-resist 4-socket Sacred Targe
hiddenValue_bases.keep: Low-str paladin/spirit base with max sockets and max auto-resist prefix. Genuinely obscure, and the roll stack is the value.

hiddenValue_bases.name: +3 Bow Skills 4-socket Grand Matron Bow
hiddenValue_bases.keep: A magic Amazon bow with +3 bow skills and 4 sockets is the dream Faith base. The affix roll is the whole item.

hiddenValue_bases.name: Ethereal Thunder Maul
hiddenValue_bases.keep: Highest base damage two-hander. Ethereal high-socket is a smiter/zealot and PvP curio most players walk past.

hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.name: Rare +2 Skills / 20% FCR Caster Circlet
hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.keep: The canonical hidden-value rare. A dual-stat +2 class skills, 20 FCR, sockets circlet beats its unique rivals and teaches the whole 'rares can be the best item slot' lesson.
hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.userNote: User wants a real documented roll here, not a generic archetype. Pin a specific famous circlet before writing.

hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.name: Crafted Caster Amulet (+2 skills / 20% FCR)
hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.keep: Concrete recipe (Ral + perfect amethyst + magic amulet). A 2/20 with life and resists beats most unique amulets and is invisible to players who never craft.

hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.name: Rare Dual-Leech FCR Ring
hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.keep: Life leech, mana leech, 10 FCR and stats on one ring. The kind of rare that outclasses every unique ring but the game shows no gold text on it.

hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.name: Crafted Blood Gloves (10% CB / dual leech / 20 IAS)
hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.keep: Nef + perfect ruby craft that at a top roll gives crushing blow, dual leech and 20 IAS in one glove slot. Melee grail hiding as a craft.

hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.name: Rare Boots: 30 FRW / 10 FHR / Tri-Res / +Dex
hiddenValue_raresAndCrafts.keep: The boot slot has no great unique for casters, so a perfect rare with run speed, faster hit recovery, three resists and dex is the actual best in slot.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Shimmering Small Charm of Vita
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: 5 all resist and 20 life on one small charm. The 'that tiny charm is worth what?' item. Perfect roll is the whole point.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Fine Small Charm of Vita
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: 3 max damage, 20 attack rating, 20 life. The perfect melee small charm, and only the perfect one commands the price.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Skill Grand Charm of Vita (near-max life)
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: A +1 skill tab grand charm with 40+ life is the endgame charm. The right skill tree plus a near-max life roll is a small fortune.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Ruby Jewel of Fervor (40 ED / 15 IAS)
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: The perfect max-damage jewel. 40% enhanced damage and 15% IAS in one socket is chased across every melee build.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Perfect Jewel of Carnage (40 ED / 15 max)
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: The other 40/15. Flat max damage instead of IAS, which some builds value over an Ohm rune. Distinct from the Fervor jewel.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Rainbow Facet (perfect 5/5)
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: The unique jewel. A perfect 5/5 die/level-up of the right element is a chase, a poison or off-element one is a fraction of it.

hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.name: Sunder Charms
hiddenValue_charmsAndJewels.keep: Newer immunity-breaking charms with a wide value spread. Cold Rupture is a fortune, Black Cleft is not, and knowing which is which is the lesson.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Angelic Halo + Angelic Wings combo
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: User favorite. A seasoned player dismisses the set, but the two-piece attack-rating bonus scales absurdly at low levels and defines twink dueling.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Perfect Bloodfist
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: Low-level gloves that a PvM player vendors. In LLD a perfect life/FHR/IAS roll is a staple worth real currency.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Twitchthroe
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: IAS, faster hit recovery and block on a level-requirement-free armor. Invisible to PvM, foundational in low brackets.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Spectral Shard
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: Cheap-looking caster sword with big FCR and all-res at a low level requirement. An LLD caster staple.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Death's Guard + Death's Hand combo
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: The two-piece gives cannot be frozen with zero level requirement. The classic teaching case for why cheap set pieces matter in twinking.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Rare +2 Skill Tab Circlet, sub-31 req level
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: A +2 skill circlet whose required level stays inside the level-30 bracket is one of the hardest items in the game to find, and only the LLD market knows.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Perfect low-req rare dual-leech ring
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: Leech, attack rating and stats under a level-30 requirement. The affix cap fights you, so a clean one is genuinely scarce.

hiddenValue_lldMld.name: Rare +2 Bow & Crossbow / 20% IAS Gloves
hiddenValue_lldMld.keep: Bowazon glove grail. +2 to bow skills is glove-only and the IAS on top makes a rare beat every unique option.

history_economyAndMechanics.name: Stone of Jordan
history_economyAndMechanics.keep: The model item. Was the currency of D2 for years, duping wrecked it, and Blizzard's answer was a counter on SOJs sold to vendors that spawns Diablo Clone. A permanent game mechanic exists because of one ring.

history_economyAndMechanics.name: Tyrael's Might
history_economyAndMechanics.keep: The lowest drop rate of any item in the game, no strength requirement, and a legend that outran its actual power. The definition of rare over valuable.

history_economyAndMechanics.name: The Grandfather (pre-1.10, one-handed)
history_economyAndMechanics.keep: Before 1.10 the Grandfather was one-handed, which made it a different weapon entirely. A legacy collector piece from a patch that no longer exists.

history_economyAndMechanics.name: 1.08 Vampire Gaze
history_economyAndMechanics.keep: The 1.08 version had stats later patches nerfed. Surviving 08 copies trade as legacy collectibles, valued for the patch stamp not the stat line.

history_economyAndMechanics.name: Arkaine's Valor
history_economyAndMechanics.keep: A case study in patch meta shift. Once a top armor, later eclipsed, it tells the story of how the value of a fixed item moves without the item changing at all.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: The White Ring
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: A hacked ring that reached Battle.net and became folklore. Documents how illegitimate items were part of how the economy actually worked. History only, no methods.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: Constricting Ring
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: A unique ring that existed in the files but had no legitimate way to drop. The purest 'does it even exist' curio in the game.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: Oculus Stone of Jordan
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: A bug-born ring, an SOJ that carried the Oculus's teleport. A famous impossible item people still argue about.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: Ith Items (Matrix Hack)
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: Broken items from the Matrix hack era that carried impossible property combinations. A snapshot of a specific breach in the game's history.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: Hex Charm
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: An impossible charm that briefly functioned as its own currency. A folklore item that shows how the community priced things no store ever sold.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: Bugged Tal Rasha's Armor
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: A version of the Tal armor that kept a bonus it was not supposed to. A legacy quirk collectors specifically seek out.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: Mephisto-Fused Uniques (Wizardspike / Wizendraw folklore)
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: Fused items born from a specific bug, deep-cut folklore even most veterans have never seen.
history_illicitAndFolklore.verify: Confirm the exact items and the bug before writing. Highest folklore risk of the set.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: King's Jewel of Blazing
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: A jewel with an affix combination that should not be able to exist. A pure impossible-item curio.

history_illicitAndFolklore.name: The Gull
history_illicitAndFolklore.keep: A near-worthless MF dagger that became infamous for its role in trade-window safety folklore. Historic notoriety, not power. History framing only.

history_legacyPreNerf.name: Legacy Hellfire Torch (25% Firestorm)
history_legacyPreNerf.keep: The old Torch procced Firestorm at 25% instead of about 5%. A pre-nerf survivor that can no longer drop. The 'old version before the nerf' theme, and everyone knows the current Torch so the legacy one lands.
history_legacyPreNerf.verify: Exact proc rate and the patch that cut it.

history_legacyPreNerf.name: Legacy Wizardspike (+95 all resist)
history_legacyPreNerf.keep: Pre-1.08 Wizardspike gave +95% all resistance, cut to 75%. A clean, documented pre-nerf caster dagger. Likely replaces the shakier Mephisto-fused Wizzy folklore entry.
history_legacyPreNerf.verify: Confirm the 95 to 75 change and patch.

history_legacyPreNerf.name: Siggard's Stealth (the renamed Nosferatu's Coil)
history_legacyPreNerf.alias: the belt that changed its name
history_legacyPreNerf.keep: In 1.10 every existing Nosferatu's Coil was renamed to Siggard's Stealth, and a different Nosferatu's Coil started dropping. The rename swap is the story.
history_legacyPreNerf.verify: Old stats vary across sources. Confirm before writing.

history_legacyPreNerf.name: Legacy Charms (impossible pre-1.10 affixes)
history_legacyPreNerf.keep: Charms with affixes the game no longer generates: small charms with +5% run/walk, or Pestilent plus Anthrax poison charms. Impossible now, so surviving ones are pure collector pieces.
history_legacyPreNerf.verify: Pin one concrete example roll and its removed affix.

history_legacyPreNerf.name: Classic rare bows (the Ghoul Stinger era)
history_legacyPreNerf.keep: Before Lord of Destruction and runewords, a top-rolled rare bow was the bowazon endgame. The random names (Ghoul Stinger, Carrion Bow) became folklore. Not one item, a class of legendary one-off rares.
history_legacyPreNerf.note: No fixed stats exist, they were random rares. Write about the era and reconstruct a representative chase roll.
